method: Editorial core envelopes, not a parcel survey or exhaustive partition. Historical sectors from Garrido López 2024 pp. 663–679 and Cuesta del Realejo 26 excavation report pp. 470–472; modern street anchors from OSM. No affine accuracy claimed for these vertices.
unknown: The Alfareros/al-Nayd boundary is explicitly unidentified. Space between the two envelopes is an unresolved transition, not evidence of an empty strip, wall or disconnected settlement.
